title: The finish
steps: You cross the finish line and land, and a moment later Zarek lands too, for the second time. Your classmates clap, and Ilda smiles.
All right, all right. You flew clean, and with a shorter program than mine. Next time I won't let you win.

No one fell today, though this morning I found a black thread in the shed's straw that I didn't like at all. Someone was there at night. {wizard}, I haven't seen a first-year pupil complete these races on their first day for many years, let alone win them! You can keep the broom, you will need it to train as a new member of Arvelia's broom racing team.

At the edge of the field, by the gate, apart from the class, an older pupil stares at the brooms. He mutters to himself, without seeing you come near: *...he said no one would get hurt... that this way the flying lessons would end...*
It is him, the one we heard through the crack. I don't know his name. But now I am more sure than ever: the other voice was no pupil's.

You have a broom, a secret bigger than this morning's, and a voice in the walls that no one else has heard. Now you know what a list is, how to use a loop over it, and how to put an `if` in each turn. You learned how to fly, and what functions and their arguments are.
